welcomeDescription:
**<:MemberJoin:1087453129198546964> Welcome messages**

> `{0}welcome channel set <#channel>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets a welcome channel
> `{0}welcome channel remove`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Removes the welcome channel
> `{0}welcome message <message>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets a new welcome message
> `{0}welcome picture set <picture>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets a welcome picture
> `{0}welcome picture remove`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Removes the current welcome picture
> `{0}welcome picture show`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Shows you all available welcome pictures

> Variables for the welcome message are `{{user_mention}}`, `{{user_name}}`, `{{user_discriminator}}`, `{{guild_name}}`, `{{guild_membercount}}`
> You set a line break in the welcome message with: `\n`
> To remove the welcome message insert `_ _` as message

giveawayDescription:
**<a:Giveaway:1087437215648456794> Giveaway**

> `{0}giveaway create`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Starts a giveaway

> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Creates a giveaway in one command

ticketsystemDescription:
**<:Ticket:1087437978873376798> Ticket system**

> `{0}ticket create <#channel> <@role> <text>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Creates a ticket where user can react
> `{0}ticket update <#channel> <messageid> <@role> <text>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Updates a already created ticket
> `{0}ticket delete <#channel> <messageid>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Deletes a ticket
> `{0}ticket message <text>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets a new ticket opening message
> `{0}ticket list`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Shows you all tickets
> `{0}ticket log set <#channel>`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Sets a channel for the ticket log
> `{0}ticket log remove`
> <:Reply:1087438925632643082> Removes the ticket log channel

> Variables for the ticket opening message are `{{user_name}}` `{{user_discriminator}}` `{{user_mention}}` `{{ticket_link}}` `{{guild_name}}` `{{moderation_role}}`
> You set a line break with: `\n`
